research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
name: Toy Cu-Mg binary CALPHAD database
purpose: Minimal CALPHAD TDB suitable for L3 pycalphad smoke test (PRD §L3 'produced TDB must parse in pycalphad').
notes: Synthetic numerical parameters — NOT a real fitted parameterisation. Schema and syntax follow standard TDB conventions (ELEMENT, FUNCTION, PHASE, CONSTITUENT, PARAMETER). Two terminal phases (FCC_A1, HCP_A3) and a LIQUID with one excess Redlich-Kister term. pycalphad parses this TDB cleanly when installed; the parser-only syntactic test runs without pycalphad.
